test.role: held-out: scored once with the frozen selections

train.role: selection: parameter sweeps and the frozen selection rule read only this window

controls.midpoint_source: sma_crossover on close at the candidate's selected periods
controls.zero_tie: exact-zero oscillator bars and entries whose predecessor lag is above 1

protocol.selection_rule: eligible = all datasets scored, no liquidated leg, >= 10 positions; pick max mean Sharpe, then max mean DD-adjusted return, then earliest grid order
protocol.verdict_rule: inconclusive if held-out candle or funding coverage is incomplete or the candidate has < 30 independent positions; pass only if candidate mean net return > 0 at cost x1 and x2, its M1 verdict against the incumbent bar is pass at cost x1, and its mean Sharpe and mean DD-adjusted return beat each tuned comparator; otherwise fail

verdict.reason: failed frozen checks: beats_comparators_ddadj, beats_m1_incumbent_bar, net_positive_base, net_positive_stress
